doc: Before/after queries for docs/plans/field-types.md. Weft's own sources (shard stats, with per-query timings) are JSON, so every query here is a control: it must keep its output while the planner changes. The queries that benefit from typed awk fields need a text source with numeric columns (see README.md).

queries.why: numeric filter on a top-level key: slow-query windows (jq over JSON: no numeric awk column, so facts do not change its plan; the output must not change)
numeric filter, selective: windows with query errors (jq over JSON: no numeric awk column, so facts do not change its plan; the output must not change)
numeric filter on a float: volume fullness (jq over JSON: no numeric awk column, so facts do not change its plan; the output must not change)
numeric filter feeding head: when were the slow windows (jq over JSON: no numeric awk column, so facts do not change its plan; the output must not change)
sort -n | tail -n 1: the single worst query window (jq over JSON: no numeric awk column, so facts do not change its plan; the output must not change)
keyed max per shard: worst query time by shard (jq over JSON: no numeric awk column, so facts do not change its plan; the output must not change)
queries.pipeline: cat /log/weft/shard/stats.log | jq -r '[.shard_id, .q_max_ms] | @tsv' | awk '{ if ($2 > m[$1]) m[$1] = $2 } END { for (k in m) print k, m[k] }' | sort

queries.why: keyed sum per shard: queries served by shard (jq over JSON: no numeric awk column, so facts do not change its plan; the output must not change)
queries.pipeline: cat /log/weft/shard/stats.log | jq -r '[.shard_id, .q_count] | @tsv' | awk '{ s[$1] += $2 } END { for (k in s) print k, s[k] }' | sort

queries.why: keyed sum per shard: rows returned by shard (jq over JSON: no numeric awk column, so facts do not change its plan; the output must not change)
queries.pipeline: cat /log/weft/shard/stats.log | jq -r '[.shard_id, .q_rows] | @tsv' | awk '{ s[$1] += $2 } END { for (k in s) print k, s[k] }' | sort
